categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Yizhong Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. primarily focuses on the research, development, production, and sales of innovative anti-tumor drugs, with its core product being the injection of polymeric micellar paclitaxel, a 2.2 class new drug. The company operates as a high-tech pharmaceutical enterprise integrating R&D, manufacturing, and commercialization, specializing in anti-cancer drug formulations and related products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced nano drug delivery systems (NDDS) technology, polymer synthesis, and nanotechnology to develop proprietary drug formulations such as polymeric micellar paclitaxel with a particle size of about 18-20nm. It holds key patents covering pharmaceutical excipients, formulations, and manufacturing processes. The production lines comply with GMP standards, and the company is expanding capacity with a project to produce 5 million doses annually. It also develops multifunctional antibodies and small molecule targeted drugs using high-throughput virtual screening and molecular optimization.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Shanghai Yizhong serves hospitals and medical institutions primarily within China, targeting patients with various cancers including non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), breast cancer, pancreatic cancer, gastric cancer, and gynecological tumors. Its products are used in chemotherapy regimens and combined therapies, addressing a broad oncology market. The company’s sales focus on oncology specialists and clinical end-users, with a growing self-operated sales force and commercial partnerships.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with its headquarters and production facilities located in Shanghai's Fengxian District. While its current sales and clinical trials are domestic, it has strategic plans to explore overseas markets through partnerships and global promotion of its core products.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Yizhong operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain, encompassing drug formulation development, GMP-compliant manufacturing, and direct sales to hospitals and distributors. It maintains control over raw material procurement, production, quality control, and marketing, positioning itself as an integrated pharmaceutical manufacturer and marketer.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic R&D priorities include expanding indications for its core polymeric micellar paclitaxel product through ongoing Phase III clinical trials for breast and pancreatic cancers. It invests heavily in innovative drug platforms such as multifunctional antibodies targeting PD-1/VEGF/IL-2 and fourth-generation EGFR-TKI small molecules for resistant NSCLC. The firm emphasizes nanotechnology, polymer excipient innovation, and precision oncology drug development, supported by a stable and experienced R&D team and proprietary patents.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of pharmaceutical products, especially its flagship injection of polymeric micellar paclitaxel. The company employs a self-operated sales model supplemented by commercial partnerships, focusing on hospital and pharmacy channels. Revenue recognition occurs upon transfer of control of goods to customers, typically within 45 to 90 days payment terms.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Shanghai Yizhong positions itself as a leading innovator in the polymeric micellar paclitaxel segment within China, competing against other paclitaxel formulations such as conventional paclitaxel injection, liposomal paclitaxel, and albumin-bound paclitaxel (nab-paclitaxel). Its product is recognized as a 2.2 class innovative drug with clinical advantages in efficacy and safety. The company holds a first-mover advantage in this niche and is expanding its market share through clinical validation and inclusion in national medical insurance.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 173.5 million, a 51.83% decrease from the previous year, primarily due to market access challenges before its core product was included in the national medical insurance catalog. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 6.98 million, down 95.68% year-over-year. R&D investment increased significantly to RMB 37.2 million, accounting for 21.44% of revenue. The company is in a growth phase with ongoing clinical trials and capacity expansion projects, expecting long-term market growth post-insurance inclusion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai Yizhong emphasizes its polymeric micellar paclitaxel as a next-generation innovative chemotherapy drug with superior clinical efficacy, safety, and convenience compared to existing paclitaxel formulations. Its nano-sized polymer micelle technology enhances drug solubility, targeted tumor delivery, and reduces adverse reactions, eliminating the need for premedication against allergic reactions. The product is clinically validated with higher objective response rates and better tolerability, supported by multiple patents and inclusion in authoritative clinical guidelines and national insurance, offering patients effective, accessible, and affordable cancer treatment options.
